messages.author: Hana Kobayashi
messages.text:
June creative test readout (ua_spend has creative_id, so this is CPI/CTR/IPM only, cohort metrics can't be split by creative):
- Meta broad: META-BRD-02 wins on IPM, keep scaling it
- TikTok: UGC and studio creatives roughly tied
- AppLovin: no clear winner
Full deck in the Creative space.

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: Small caveat: the differences between creatives within a campaign are mostly within noise this month. I wouldn't kill anything on June data alone.

replies.author: Hana Kobayashi
replies.text: Agreed, nothing gets killed, we're just rotating in new variants.
